paragraphs: Abba Shaul bar Nash, and some say bar Ramash.

In [Niddah 25b](https://www.sefaria.org/Niddah.25b.3-4) he asks how to determine whether a miscarried fetus is male or female, and says to bring a splinter, etc. Rabbah bar Avuha comments on this, “This was taught only from below upwards,” etc. Hyman suggests he may have been one of the late Tannaim and that his words belong to the baraita recited by R”Ch there.

notes.text: ע״ז means on this here, not the tractate Avodah Zarah. The baraita-reciter initials R”Ch remain unresolved. The historical suggestion is Hyman’s, and the fetus-test quotation remains abbreviated.

The examination discussion begins on [Niddah 25a](https://www.sefaria.org/Niddah.25a.24-25), where Rabbi Chiyya is named. The Gemara on 25b has Rav Nachman transmit the qualification in Rabbah bar Avuha’s name. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3262&lang=en) also records both forms of Abba Shaul’s name.

Niddah 25a explicitly introduces Rabbi Chiyya before the examination discussion, which continues on 25b. There Abba Shaul bar Nash is also called bar Remesh. Rav Nachman reports Rabbah bar Avuha’s qualification about moving the splinter from below upwards. Hyman gives the shorter quotation and proposes both Abba Shaul’s date and how his words fit into the baraita.
